out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at cook line or prep area handwashing sinks.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. Person in charge provided paper towels at all hand sinks.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the back prep area being used to store metal food storage containers.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. Person in charge removed containers.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. Person in charge ordered thermometer during inspection.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the bottom edge of the front doors.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. Person in charge will repair doors before next routine inspection.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Safe Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not safe: Home Depot 5 gallon bucket in 2 door upright cooler used for storage of spicy sauce.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be safe. Person in charge discarded 5 gallon bucket and will replace with a food grade 5 gallon bucket.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical quaternary ammonia sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Person in charge ordered quaternary ammonia test strips during inspection.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Toilet Rooms Enclosed
violations.observation: Toilet room is provided with self-closing door that is not fully closing after use.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a self-closing hinge or closing mechanism for the toilet room door. Person in charge will replace or repair self closing door before next routine inspection.
